title: Oh, This Unspeakable Void (KINO)
synopsis: At 20, Joachim is unexpectedly awarded a place at Munich's prestigious Otto Falckenberg School of the Performing Arts and moves into his grandparents' villa. Between the bizarre challenges of drama school and the eccentric, mostly alcohol-fuelled rituals of Inge and Hermann, he tries to find his place in the world. Simon Verhoeven adapts Joachim Meyerhoff's autobiographical bestseller with insane humour and deep feeling, directing his own mother, screen legend Senta Berger. A box office phenomenon with over a million admissions, the film won three German Film Awards 2026, including Best Feature Film in Bronze and acting honours for Berger and Michael Wittenborn.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 20歲的約謙無心插柳之下被慕尼克享負盛名的演藝學院錄取，決定搬到祖父母的豪華別墅和他們同住。和曾是演員的祖母和退休哲學教授祖父同一屋簷下，祖父的騎呢舉動令他大開眼界，家居日常秒變戲劇現場。約謙夾在學院課程的古怪要求及兩老的妙趣行為之中，每日生活都有如一場又一場無法預料的冒險。導演西蒙費浩雲改編德國導演及演員約謙米耶霍夫暢銷自傳，喜鬧之間處處散發細緻親情，獲三項2026德國電影獎。
